name: Recreus Filaflex 95A Foamy

retraction.note: Recreus's print parameters for Foamy (checked 21 October 2026): 2.5-5.0 mm at 65 mm/s, 0.2 mm z-hop, travel as fast as the printer allows. 4 mm on every travel, however short (min_travel 0), pushed back the same 4 mm. 6 mm out and 7 back (restart_extra 1) left a blob at every restart; 2.5 out and 2.5 back started thin for the first 6 cm. If a start is thin, raise restart_extra in 0.1 mm steps (0.1-0.4); tools/export-retraction-test.mjs writes swatches to compare.

notes: Dry at 55 C for at least 1 h. Direct-drive extruder recommended. Foams at 245-250 C; lower flow and higher temperature foam more.
